{"thought": "時間欄位格式未知，先抽樣檢視 shipments 與 orders 的時間字串，確認如何計算配送天數與 2025 年歸屬。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT s.shipment_id, s.carrier, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts, o.order_ts, o.status FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE s.carrier = 'hct' LIMIT 10", "SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(delivered_ts IS NOT NULL) AS delivered_n FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier"]}}

response: {"thought": "依語意層定義：hct 為新竹物流；分母為 2025 年訂單下已送達的 hct 出貨，分子為配送秒數 ≤ 259200（3 天，含邊界）的出貨。用整數秒比較以避免浮點誤差。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_n, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s', s.delivered_ts) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%s', s.shipped_ts) AS INTEGER) <= 259200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_n, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s', s.delivered_ts) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%s', s.shipped_ts) AS INTEGER) <= 259200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS on_time_rate FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE s.carrier = 'hct' AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND o.order_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < '2026-01-01'", "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN s.delivered_ts < s.shipped_ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_duration_n, SUM(CASE WHEN length(s.delivered_ts) <> 19 OR length(s.shipped_ts) <> 19 OR length(o.order_ts) <> 19 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_format_n, MIN(o.order_ts) AS min_order_ts, MAX(o.order_ts) AS max_order_ts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipments x WHERE x.carrier = 'hct' AND x.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND x.order_id NOT IN (SELECT order_id FROM orders)) AS orphan_delivered_n FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE s.carrier = 'hct' AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND o.order_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < '2026-01-01'"]}}
